mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods (goods_id, goods_desc, price, original_price, tags, is_deleted) VALUES (#{goodsId}, #{goodsDesc}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{tags}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.select: SELECT goods_id AS goodsId, goods_desc AS goodsDesc, price AS price, original_price AS originalPrice, tags AS tags, is_deleted AS isDeleted, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM goods WHERE goods_id = #{id}

SELECT goods_id AS goodsId, goods_desc AS goodsDesc, price AS price, original_price AS originalPrice, tags AS tags, is_deleted AS isDeleted, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM goods WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
